![low](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/low-priority.svg)

The `season` parameter is no longer used in this function but remains in the signature, where it is ignored (`_ string`). To improve code clarity and maintainability, it would be best to remove this parameter from the function signature and update all call sites.

![low](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/low-priority.svg)

The concurrency limit `accuracyTrendConcurrency` is hardcoded. According to the repository's general rules, tunable parameters should be configurable. Consider moving this to a configuration file to allow for easier tuning without code changes.

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Avoid hardcoded values; make parameters configurable.
</details>
